Teams assume Cover to Mute behavior on Apple Watch covers storefront language. watchOS Sounds & Haptics, ambient-light palm detection, and App Store Connect actually separate on-device Cover to Mute routing from product-page copy:

  • Settings → Sounds & Haptics → Cover to Mute — system toggle on Apple Watch. When enabled, covering the display with your palm while an alert is sounding instantly mutes that alert. watchOS labels it 捂住静音 in Simplified Chinese. Does not generate Chinese listing text by itself.
  • Palm-over-display gesture — buyers place an open hand over the watch face to hush a ringing notification or call without navigating Control Center. Gallery frames may show hand-over-watch demo art — listing copy should use 用手捂住静音 or 盖住表盘静音 when that is what the screenshot depicts.
  • Reactive alert silencing vs persistent mute — Cover to Mute silences the alert sounding right now. Silent Mode keeps alerts muted until the buyer toggles bell/silent back. Your description may explain both; conflating them on one gallery frame confuses China buyers.
  • Companion app documentation — your app may teach when to enable Cover to Mute before a meeting. Your description may mention that behavior; implementing alert policies is engineering — distinct from zh-Hans caption lines.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Cover to Mute support in the binary.

How Cover to Mute differs from Silent Mode and Theater Mode — listing honesty

Apple ships several related but distinct quiet-venue experiences on Apple Watch. AppLocale rewrites listing copy from what your US page already claims — without conflating them on the zh-Hans product page:

  • Cover to Mute (捂住静音) — reactive palm-over-display gesture that silences the alert currently sounding. Buyers cover the watch face once to hush one notification or call ring. Your gallery may show hand-over-watch demos or Cover to Mute setup. This is the lead feature on this page.
  • Silent Mode (静音模式) — persistent mute via iPhone Ring/Silent switch or watchOS bell/silent Control Center toggle — alerts stay silent until the buyer turns mute off.
  • Theater Mode (剧院模式) — cinema dim that silences alerts and keeps the display dark when the wearer raises their wrist in a dark venue — venue-specific dim plus mute, not a one-hand palm cover during one ring.

Cover to Mute-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Cover to Mute marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general watch guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe palm-over-display alert silencing — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Cover to Mute vs Silent Mode

US pages use "Cover to Mute", "Cover your watch to mute", or "Palm mute." China storefront copy often uses 捂住静音 for Apple's Cover to Mute feature name, 用手捂住静音 when the frame shows hand-over-watch demos, or 盖住表盘静音 when marketing emphasizes covering the display — depending on whether you mean the Settings toggle, the palm gesture demo, or the instant-hush benefit. Silent Mode (静音模式) covers persistent bell/silent toggles — do not reuse 静音模式 vocabulary on Cover to Mute gallery frames unless that frame actually shows Silent Mode UI.

Cover to Mute vs Theater Mode

Cover to Mute (捂住静音) silences one alert with a palm cover while it rings. Theater Mode (剧院模式) dims the display and silences alerts on wrist raise in dark venues. Do not reuse 剧院模式 vocabulary on palm-mute demo frames unless that is what the screenshot depicts.

Cover to Mute vs Double Tap and wrist-flick

Double Tap (轻点两下) covers pinch-twice primary actions on supported Apple Watch models. Wrist-flick dismiss covers a separate flick gesture story. Cover to Mute is palm-over-display alert hush — 捂住静音. Related wrist hardware, different buyer stories — match what your gallery shows per frame.

Cover to Mute vs AirPods audio pages

Adaptive Audio (自适应音频), Automatic Switching (自动切换), and sibling AirPods guides cover headphone listening modes — not Apple Watch palm mute. Do not paste AirPods ANC or adaptive-blend vocabulary onto Cover to Mute watch gallery frames.
